local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local combatFolder = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("CombatSystem") or script.Parent
local punchRemote = combatFolder:FindFirstChild("Punching")
if not punchRemote then
	punchRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	punchRemote.Name = "Punching"
	punchRemote.Parent = combatFolder
end

local resetRemote = combatFolder:FindFirstChild("ResetEvent")
if not resetRemote then
	resetRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	resetRemote.Name = "ResetEvent"
	resetRemote.Parent = combatFolder
end

local soundPunched1 = combatFolder:FindFirstChild("Punched1")
local soundPunched2 = combatFolder:FindFirstChild("Punched2")
local soundSwing = combatFolder:FindFirstChild("Swing")
local hitEffect = combatFolder:FindFirstChild("HitEffect")

local COMBO_CONFIG = {
	[1] = { damage = 20, windup = 0.16, recovery = 0.24, sound = soundPunched1 },
	[2] = { damage = 30, windup = 0.18, recovery = 0.26, sound = soundPunched2 },
	[3] = { damage = 50, windup = 0.24, recovery = 0.38, sound = soundPunched2 or soundPunched1 },
}
local MAX_RANGE = 7.0
local MAX_ANGLE_DOT = 0.25
local COMBO_WINDOW = 1.0
local AUTO_RESET_DELAY = 2.5

-- Arena & Dummy Setup
local dummyModel = Workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainingDummy")
local dummyHumanoid = nil
local dummyHRP = nil
local dummySpawnCFrame = CFrame.new(0, 3, -12)

local function ensureDummy()
	if dummyModel and dummyModel.Parent then return dummyModel end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "TrainingDummy"
	
	local hrp = Instance.new("Part")
	hrp.Name = "HumanoidRootPart"
	hrp.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
	hrp.CFrame = dummySpawnCFrame
	hrp.Anchored = true
	hrp.CanCollide = false
	hrp.Transparency = 1
	hrp.Parent = model
	
	local torso = Instance.new("Part")
	torso.Name = "UpperTorso"
	torso.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
	torso.CFrame = dummySpawnCFrame
	torso.Anchored = true
	torso.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	torso.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Medium stone grey")
	torso.Parent = model
	
	local head = Instance.new("Part")
	head.Name = "Head"
	head.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)
	head.CFrame = dummySpawnCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	head.Anchored = true
	head.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
	head.Parent = model
	
	local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	hum.MaxHealth = 100
	hum.Health = 100
	hum.Parent = model
	
	model.PrimaryPart = hrp
	model.Parent = Workspace
	dummyModel = model
	dummyHumanoid = hum
	dummyHRP = hrp
	return model
end

ensureDummy()
if dummyModel then
	dummyHumanoid = dummyModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	dummyHRP = dummyModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or dummyModel.PrimaryPart
	if dummyHRP then dummySpawnCFrame = dummyHRP.CFrame end
end

local gameState = {
	dummyHealth = 100,
	acceptedHits = 0,
	isDefeated = false,
	lastHitTime = 0,
}

local playerState = {}

local function broadcastState()
	punchRemote:FireAllClients("StateUpdate", {
		dummyHealth = gameState.dummyHealth,
		acceptedHits = gameState.acceptedHits,
		isDefeated = gameState.isDefeated,
	})
end

local function resetArena(sourcePlayer)
	gameState.dummyHealth = 100
	gameState.acceptedHits = 0
	gameState.isDefeated = false
	if dummyHumanoid then
		dummyHumanoid.Health = 100
	end
	if dummyHRP then
		dummyHRP.CFrame = dummySpawnCFrame
	end
	for _, pData in pairs(playerState) do
		pData.comboStep = 1
		pData.lastAttackTime = 0
		pData.isBusy = false
	end
	broadcastState()
	resetRemote:FireAllClients("ResetConfirmed")
end

local function handleAttack(player, swingToken, clientStep)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	if gameState.isDefeated then return end

	local now = os.clock()
	local pData = playerState[player.UserId]
	if not pData then
		pData = { comboStep = 1, lastAttackTime = 0, isBusy = false, swingCount = 0 }
		playerState[player.UserId] = pData
	end

	-- Combo expiration check
	if now - pData.lastAttackTime > COMBO_WINDOW then
		pData.comboStep = 1
	end

	local activeStep = pData.comboStep
	local config = COMBO_CONFIG[activeStep] or COMBO_CONFIG[1]

	-- Recovery locking check
	if pData.isBusy then
		punchRemote:FireClient(player, "Feedback", { result = "REJECTED", reason = "Busy" })
		return
	end

	pData.isBusy = true
	pData.swingCount += 1
	local thisSwingId = pData.swingCount
	pData.lastAttackTime = now

	-- Play spatial swing sound at character
	if soundSwing then
		local s = soundSwing:Clone()
		s.Parent = hrp
		s:Play()
		Debris:AddItem(s, 1.5)
	end

	-- Contact validation scheduled after windup
	task.delay(config.windup, function()
		if not player.Parent or not char.Parent or gameState.isDefeated then
			pData.isBusy = false
			return
		end

		local targetPos = dummyHRP and dummyHRP.Position or dummySpawnCFrame.Position
		local playerPos = hrp.Position
		local toTarget = (targetPos - playerPos)
		local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
		local lookVec = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
		local dir = toTarget.Unit
		local dot = lookVec:Dot(dir)

		local isHit = (dist <= MAX_RANGE) and (dot >= MAX_ANGLE_DOT)

		if isHit and not gameState.isDefeated then
			-- Accepted Hit
			gameState.acceptedHits += 1
			gameState.dummyHealth = math.clamp(gameState.dummyHealth - config.damage, 0, 100)
			if dummyHumanoid then dummyHumanoid.Health = gameState.dummyHealth end

			-- Audio feedback
			if config.sound and dummyHRP then
				local snd = config.sound:Clone()
				snd.Parent = dummyHRP
				snd:Play()
				Debris:AddItem(snd, 1.5)
			end

			-- Particle feedback
			if hitEffect and dummyModel:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") then
				local fx = hitEffect:Clone()
				fx.Parent = dummyModel.UpperTorso
				fx:Emit(15)
				Debris:AddItem(fx, 1.5)
			end

			-- Replicate hit event
			punchRemote:FireAllClients("HitAccepted", {
				step = activeStep,
				damage = config.damage,
				remainingHealth = gameState.dummyHealth,
				totalHits = gameState.acceptedHits,
				attacker = player,
			})

			-- Check KO defeat
			if gameState.dummyHealth <= 0 then
				gameState.isDefeated = true
				punchRemote:FireAllClients("DummyDefeated", {
					totalHits = gameState.acceptedHits,
					resetIn = AUTO_RESET_DELAY,
				})
				task.delay(AUTO_RESET_DELAY, function()
					if gameState.isDefeated then
						resetArena()
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			-- Whiff / Miss feedback
			punchRemote:FireClient(player, "Feedback", {
				result = "MISS",
				step = activeStep,
				reason = dist > MAX_RANGE and "Out of range" or "Off target",
			})
		end

		-- Advance combo step
		if activeStep >= 3 then
			pData.comboStep = 1
		else
			pData.comboStep = activeStep + 1
		end

		-- Recovery delay before next allowed strike
		task.delay(config.recovery, function()
			if pData.swingCount == thisSwingId then
				pData.isBusy = false
			end
		end)
	end)
end

punchRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, payload)
	if action == "Attack" then
		handleAttack(player, payload and payload.token, payload and payload.step)
	elseif action == "RequestState" then
		broadcastState()
	end
end)

resetRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	resetArena(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	playerState[player.UserId] = nil
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local combatFolder = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("CombatSystem") or script.Parent
local punchRemote = combatFolder:WaitForChild("Punching")
local resetRemote = combatFolder:WaitForChild("ResetEvent")

local combatAnimations = combatFolder:FindFirstChild("CombatAnimations")
local leftPunchAnim = combatAnimations and combatAnimations:FindFirstChild("LeftPunch")
local rightPunchAnim = combatAnimations and combatAnimations:FindFirstChild("RightPunch")

local loadedTracks = {}
local function loadTracks(humanoid)
	loadedTracks = {}
	if not humanoid then return end
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid
	if leftPunchAnim then
		pcall(function() loadedTracks[1] = animator:LoadAnimation(leftPunchAnim) end)
	end
	if rightPunchAnim then
		pcall(function() loadedTracks[2] = animator:LoadAnimation(rightPunchAnim) end)
	end
	-- Third hit uses punch track if dedicated third track is unprovided
	loadedTracks[3] = loadedTracks[1] or loadedTracks[2]
end

local currentCombo = 1
local isAttacking = false
local lastInputTime = 0

-- UI Construction
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "StrikeLabHUD"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Top Health & Hit Counter Container
local topFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
topFrame.Name = "TopFrame"
topFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 100)
topFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0, 20)
topFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 28)
topFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
topFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
topFrame.Parent = screenGui

local topCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
topCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
topCorner.Parent = topFrame

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleLabel.Text = "TRAINING DUMMY"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
titleLabel.TextSize = 14
titleLabel.Parent = topFrame

local healthBg = Instance.new("Frame")
healthBg.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 16)
healthBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 32)
healthBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 52)
healthBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
healthBg.Parent = topFrame

local healthCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
healthCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
healthCorner.Parent = healthBg

local healthBar = Instance.new("Frame")
healthBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
healthBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 40)
healthBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
healthBar.Parent = healthBg

local healthBarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
healthBarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
healthBarCorner.Parent = healthBar

local statsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
statsLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 54)
statsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statsLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
statsLabel.Text = "HP: 100/100   |   Hits Landed: 0   |   Combo: Step 1"
statsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 240)
statsLabel.TextSize = 13
statsLabel.Parent = topFrame

-- Feedback Banner
local feedbackLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
feedbackLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 30)
feedbackLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -120, 0, 130)
feedbackLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
feedbackLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
feedbackLabel.Text = ""
feedbackLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 40)
feedbackLabel.TextSize = 18
feedbackLabel.Parent = screenGui

-- Mobile / Touch Controls
local touchFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
touchFrame.Name = "TouchControls"
touchFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 90)
touchFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -200, 1, -110)
touchFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
touchFrame.Parent = screenGui

local attackBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
attackBtn.Name = "AttackBtn"
attackBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 80)
attackBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 5)
attackBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
attackBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
attackBtn.Text = "STRIKE\n[F / M1]"
attackBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
attackBtn.TextSize = 13
attackBtn.Parent = touchFrame

local attackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
attackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 40)
attackCorner.Parent = attackBtn

local resetBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
resetBtn.Name = "ResetBtn"
resetBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 80)
resetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 95, 0, 5)
resetBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 200)
resetBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
resetBtn.Text = "RESET\n[R]"
resetBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
resetBtn.TextSize = 13
resetBtn.Parent = touchFrame

local resetCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
resetCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 40)
resetCorner.Parent = resetBtn

local function updateStatsDisplay(hp, hits, isDefeated)
	local percent = math.clamp(hp / 100, 0, 1)
	TweenService:Create(healthBar, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0) }):Play()
	if isDefeated then
		statsLabel.Text = string.format("HP: 0/100  |  Hits Landed: %d  |  KO! Resetting...", hits)
	else
		statsLabel.Text = string.format("HP: %d/100  |  Hits Landed: %d  |  Combo: Step %d", hp, hits, currentCombo)
	end
end

local function showFeedback(text, color)
	feedbackLabel.Text = text
	feedbackLabel.TextColor3 = color
	feedbackLabel.TextTransparency = 0
	task.delay(0.8, function()
		TweenService:Create(feedbackLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	end)
end

local function doAttack()
	if isAttacking then return end
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

	isAttacking = true
	local step = currentCombo
	
	-- Play attack animation track
	local track = loadedTracks[step]
	if track then
		track:Play(0.05, 1, 1.2)
	end

	-- Fire authoritative attack request to server
	punchRemote:FireServer("Attack", { step = step, token = os.clock() })

	-- Client step advance
	if currentCombo >= 3 then
		currentCombo = 1
	else
		currentCombo = currentCombo + 1
	end

	task.delay(0.4, function()
		isAttacking = false
	end)
end

local function doReset()
	currentCombo = 1
	resetRemote:FireServer()
	showFeedback("ARENA RESET", Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120))
end

attackBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doAttack)
resetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doReset)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
		doAttack()
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
		doReset()
	end
end)

punchRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(eventType, data)
	if eventType == "StateUpdate" then
		updateStatsDisplay(data.dummyHealth, data.acceptedHits, data.isDefeated)
	elseif eventType == "HitAccepted" then
		showFeedback("HIT! +" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70))
		updateStatsDisplay(data.remainingHealth, data.totalHits, false)
	elseif eventType == "Feedback" then
		if data.result == "MISS" then
			showFeedback("MISS (Whiff)", Color3.fromRGB(240, 180, 50))
		end
	elseif eventType == "DummyDefeated" then
		showFeedback("TARGET KO!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
		updateStatsDisplay(0, data.totalHits, true)
	end
end)

resetRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(eventType)
	if eventType == "ResetConfirmed" then
		currentCombo = 1
		updateStatsDisplay(100, 0, false)
	end
end)

local function onCharacter(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	loadTracks(hum)
	currentCombo = 1
	isAttacking = false
	punchRemote:FireServer("RequestState")
end

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
